automationEditor.readOnly: Only the person who made this automation, or an admin, can edit it.
automationEditor.loadError: The lists and campaigns of this client could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
automationEditor.leave: Your edits are not saved. Leave this page?

fields.name: Name

when.manual: Only when someone presses Run now on its page.
when.daily: Once a day. The first run starts within a minute after the automation is resumed.
when.weekly: Once a week. The first run starts within a minute after the automation is resumed.
when.webhook: Each time a tool you connect sends a signed call that names one person of the list. After you save, the automation's page gives the URL and the secret.
when.signal: Each time the signals of a company of the watchlist reach the minimum score. Each run looks for people at that company only.

fields.listHint: The people it works on. The people it finds are added to this list.
fields.listEmpty: You have no people lists yet. <link>Open a chat</link> and describe who you want to reach: the list is created when the search starts.
fields.capHint: A run stops when it reaches this number of credits. From 1 to {max, number, credits}.

signal.watchlistHint: The companies it watches for signals. With Find people, search the company list of this watchlist.
signal.watchlistHintList: The companies it watches for signals. With Find people, search {list}, the company list of this watchlist.
signal.deleted: The watchlist of this automation was deleted. Pick another one.
signal.minScoreHint: A job posting scores up to 100 when it goes up, and its score halves every 30 days. A company's signals add up. From above 0 to 10,000.
signal.noWatchlist: This client has no watchlist yet, so no signal can start a run.
signal.unreadable: The watchlists could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

steps.title: Steps
steps.hint: The steps always run in this order. Turn on the steps you need.

find_people.hint: Finds people at the companies of a company list. Free.
find_people.accountsHint: Each run takes the next companies of this list, in list order.
find_people.titlesHint: One title on each line, up to 10.
find_people.senioritiesHint: Leave all off to take any seniority.

qualify.hint: The AI gives each person a score from 0 to 100 against your brief. 1 credit for each person it scores.
qualify.briefHint: Describe the people you want, in up to 1000 characters.
qualify.minScoreHint: A person with a lower score stops here. From 0 to 100.

find_emails.hint: Finds a verified work email for a person who has none. 1 credit when it finds one.

add_to_campaign.hint: Adds the people to a campaign. It never starts the campaign and sends nothing itself.
add_to_campaign.campaignHint: Only campaigns that have not ended.

write_hubspot.hint: Writes each contact and its company to HubSpot. Needs HubSpot connected with write-back on.
write_hubspot.creator: Runs write to the HubSpot of the person who made this automation, not to yours.

add_to_instantly.hint: Adds the people to an Instantly campaign of this client, with the standard fields. Zenbree never starts or changes the campaign. Free.
add_to_instantly.campaignHint: The campaigns of the Instantly workspace connected to this client.
add_to_instantly.sends: This campaign is running: Instantly can start emailing people as soon as they are added. For each new version, nobody is added until you approve its first run.
add_to_instantly.notConnected: Connect Instantly to this client to pick a campaign.
add_to_instantly.unreadable: The Instantly campaigns could not be loaded.
add_to_instantly.keepsSaved: The chosen campaign stays saved until you pick another one.

gaps.title: To finish
gaps.name: Give the automation a name, up to 120 characters.
gaps.noStep: Turn on at least one step.
gaps.accounts: Pick the company list to find people at.
gaps.titles: Write 1 to 10 job titles, each up to 200 characters.
gaps.perAccount: Set the people at each company from 1 to 5.
gaps.brief: Describe who fits, in up to 1000 characters.
gaps.minScore: Set the minimum score from 0 to 100.
gaps.cap: Set the credit cap from 1 to 100.
gaps.oneSystem: Choose Add to campaign or Add to Instantly: an automation can use only one of them.
gaps.signalScore: Set the minimum signal score above 0 and up to 10,000.

preview.title: Preview
preview.readsOnly: The preview only reads. It spends no credits and writes nothing, in Zenbree or outside it.
preview.notYet: Press Preview to check this automation.
preview.failed: The preview could not be loaded. Try again.
preview.ready: Everything it needs is in place.
preview.problemsPaused: Fix these before you resume it
preview.pausedSaves: It is paused, so you can save it. When you resume it, Zenbree checks these again and keeps it paused while one is left.
preview.hubspotOfCreator: Runs write to the HubSpot of the person who made this automation.

records.title: Records
records.people: People in the list that it has not taken yet
records.withContact: Of those, with an email or LinkedIn
records.accountsNote: Each run looks at up to {n, plural, one {# company} other {{n, number, credits} companies}}, the next ones in list order.
records.accountsNoteSignal: Each run looks only at the company whose signals started it.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.perAccount: Up to {n, plural, one {# person} other {{n, number, credits} people}} at each company

preview.each: {n, plural, one {# credit} other {{n, number, credits} credits}} a person
preview.activeCampaign: This campaign is running. After you approve a review run, later runs add people as active, and the campaign sends to them.
preview.perRun: People in each run, at most
preview.maxCredits: Credits in each run, at most
preview.people: {n, plural, one {# person} other {{n, number, credits} people}}
preview.credits: {n, plural, one {# credit} other {{n, number, credits} credits}}
preview.instantlySends: This Instantly campaign is running. Once you approve the first run, people are added right away and Instantly can start emailing them. Later runs add people with no review.
preview.instantlyUnreadable: We cannot read the campaign on Instantly right now. The run checks it again when it reaches this step.

signals.title: Recent signals
signals.accounts: {n, plural, =0 {No company of the watchlist has signals from the last 30 days that reach the minimum score.} one {# company of the watchlist has signals from the last 30 days that reach the minimum score.} other {{n, number, credits} companies of the watchlist have signals from the last 30 days that reach the minimum score.}}
signals.fromNow: These are the companies of the last 30 days whose signals reach the minimum score. Only signals that arrive after the automation is active start runs.

save.createsPaused: It is made paused, so nothing runs yet. Resume it on its page to start it. A daily or weekly automation then runs within a minute.

effects.newVersion: The next runs use version {next, number, credits}.
effects.queuedCancelled: A run waiting in the queue, if any, is cancelled.
effects.runningFinishes: A run in progress, if any, finishes on the version it started with.
effects.nextReview: The next run is a review run.
effects.reviewDrafts: The people the review run adds enter the campaign as drafts until you approve the run.
effects.reviewHubspot: The review run writes nothing to HubSpot until you approve it.
effects.draftsRemoved: People that a review run added as drafts leave the campaign if no run of its version was approved.
effects.scheduleStarts: The first scheduled run starts within a minute.
effects.scheduleOnResume: The first scheduled run starts within a minute after you resume the automation.
effects.queuedStillRuns: The schedule stops. A run that it already queued still runs.
effects.campaignSends: The campaign is running. After you approve the review run, later runs add people as active, and the campaign sends to them.
effects.webhookSecretNext: After you save, make the secret on the automation's page. Until then no call is taken.
effects.webhookStops: The webhook URL and its secret stop working at once, and calls that wait are dropped. If you switch back, the automation gets a new URL and secret.
effects.signalStops: The automation no longer starts from the watchlist's signals: its watchlist and minimum score are removed.
effects.reviewInstantly: Nobody is added to Instantly until you approve the first run.
effects.instantlyReleased: People waiting for Instantly from a run that was not approved are not added. The next run takes them again.
effects.instantlyCampaignDropped: People waiting for the earlier Instantly campaign are no longer added, even if their run was approved. The next run takes them again.
effects.instantlySends: The Instantly campaign is running. After the approval, later runs add people and Instantly can start emailing them.
effects.signalFromNow: Only signals that arrive after this save start runs, and none while the automation is paused.

confirm.publish: The runs that already ran keep version {version, number, credits}.
confirm.save: The changes apply to the next runs.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.runs: Its runs and their history are deleted.
delete.running: A run in progress stops before it stores its next step, and the credits it held and did not spend go back to the client.
delete.people: People it added to a campaign stay there. People still waiting as drafts stay drafts.
